root_cause.text: The function `flow_change()` assumes `block->q` is always non-NULL when deriving a default baseclass, but shared blocks have `block->q` set to NULL, leading to a NULL pointer dereference when `tcf_block_q()` returns NULL and `q->handle` is accessed.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds `if (tcf_block_shared(block))` check before calling `tcf_block_q()` and dereferencing `q->handle`, returning -EINVAL for shared blocks. The commit message and KASAN report confirm the null-ptr-deref occurs at `flow_change` line 508 when accessing `q->handle`.

intent_record.intent_summary: Add a guard to require explicit baseclass when attaching flow filter to a shared TC block.
intent_record.what: Added a check for shared blocks in flow_change, retrieving the block pointer, checking if it is shared via tcf_block_shared(), and if so, setting an extack error and jumping to err2.
intent_record.how: Prevents attaching a flow filter to a shared block without specifying baseclass, which previously could lead to incorrect baseclass assignment when the block has no single Qdisc handle.
